      Interior-tensor fiber as a LeftEndHilbert L — specific to the A = End L case, since the fiber's leftEnd is a StarAlgHom (End L) …. For an arbitrary coefficient algebra A the left action is corrTensorMapLeft : StarAlgHom A … directly (no LeftEndHilbert wrapper).
